titleEn: The Glory of Kings — The Death of the Philistine King (ch. 81)
part: ch. 81 — The Death of the Philistine King
about: Akemehel, Samson's son by Delilah, demands the throne of the Philistines. One day, when the boys are drinking, the young king snatches the meat from his mouth, and Akemehel cuts off his head with a sword. The boy's mother Delilah rushes to kill him, but her sister Meksaba, the king's mother, disarms her, hides the death and sets him on the throne. The chapter ends by saying the Philistine kingdom, too, belongs to the seed of Shem.

sentences.t: ፹፩ ፡ ዘከመ ፡ ቀተሎ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ሳምሶን ፡ ለወልደ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ኢሎፍሊ ።
sentences.l: 81. How killed-him son-of Samson the-son-of king-of Philistines.
sentences.i: Chapter 81: How the son of Samson killed the son of the king of the Philistines.
sentences.n: Chapter heading. ዘከመ 'how' (ዘ- + ከመ) introduces the story. ቀተሎ is ቀተለ 'killed' (3ms perfect) + -ሁ 'him' (assimilated to -ኦ). ወልደ is construct: ወልደ ሳምሶን 'son-of Samson'; ለወልደ ንጉሠ ኢሎፍሊ 'the son of the king of the Philistines' has ለ- marking the object (a common Geʿez way to mark a definite object), with ንጉሠ the construct of ንጉሥ 'king'. The ፹፩ is the numeral 81. The 'son of Samson' is Delilah's boy (Menahem in ch. 80, called Akemehel here).

sentences.t: ወውእቱሰ ፡ ወልድ ፡ አከምሔል ፡ ወልደ ፡ ሳምሶን ፡ ወይቤላ ፡ ለእሙ ፡ ደሊላ ፡ ለምንት ፡ አነ ፡ ኢይነግሥ ፡ ወኢይነብር ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ መንበር ።
sentences.l: And-he-as-for son Akemehel son-of Samson, and-said-to-her to-his-mother Delilah: Why I not-reign and-not-sit upon this throne?
sentences.i: As for him, the boy Akemehel, the son of Samson, he said to his mother Delilah: 'Why do I not reign and sit on this throne?'
sentences.n: ወውእቱሰ 'and as for him': ወ- 'and' + ውእቱ 'he' + enclitic -ሰ (topic or contrast). አከምሔል is the Geʿez form of the boy's name (spelled ኣኬሜሔል a few lines later); ch. 80 called Delilah's son Menahem, so this is probably the same boy under another name (?). ወልድ is in apposition: 'the son Akemehel, son-of Samson' (ወልደ construct). ወይቤላ 'and he said to her' (ይቤ 3ms perfect of ይቤ 'say', + -ላ 'to her'), with the recipient repeated by ለእሙ 'to his mother' (ለ- + እም 'mother' + -ሁ 'his'). ለምንት 'why' (ለ- + ምንት 'what'). ኢይነግሥ and ወኢይነብር carry the 3ms prefix ይ- although አነ 'I' is the subject (the regular 1cs would be ኢእነግሥ); the imperfect with ኢ- 'not' is read as 'I do not reign / sit' (?). ላዕለ 'upon'; ዝንቱ 'this' (m.) with መንበር 'throne'.

sentences.t: ወትቤሎ ፡ እሙ ፡ ኅድግ ፡ ወልድየ ፡ ኢኮነት ፡ ዛቲ ፡ መንበር ፡ ዘአቡከ ፡ ወኢኮነ ፡ ዝየ ፡ ሀገሩ ፡ ለአቡከ ፤
sentences.l: And-said-to-him his-mother: Leave, my-son; not-was this throne of-your-father, and-not-was here his-country, your-father's.
sentences.i: His mother said to him: 'Leave it, my son. This throne was not your father's, and your father's country was not here.'
sentences.n: ወትቤሎ 'and she said to him' (ትቤ 3fs perfect + -ሎ 'to him'); እሙ 'his mother'. ኅድግ is the imperative of ኀደገ 'leave, let go, give up'. ወልድየ 'my son' (-የ 'my'). ኢኮነት 'was not' (ኢ- + ኮነት, 3fs perfect of ኮነ 'be', feminine to agree with መንበር) and ኢኮነ 'was not' (3ms, agreeing with ሀገር); ዛቲ is the feminine 'this' (the throne is treated as feminine here, unlike ዝንቱ in the previous unit). ዘአቡከ 'of your father' (ዘ- 'of' + አብ 'father' + -ከ 'your'). ሀገሩ ለአቡከ 'his country, your father's': the suffix -ሁ anticipates the genitive ለአቡከ, a common Geʿez way to say 'X's Y'.

sentences.t: ወአንተሰ ፡ ለእመ ፡ አልሀቀከ ፡ አምላከ ፡ አበዊከ ፡ ተሐውር ፡ ኀበ ፡ መንበረ ፡ አቡከ ፡ ወይቤላ ፡ ወልዳ ፡ አልቦ ፡ ኢየኀድግ ፡ ኪያኪ ፡ እምየ ፡ ወመክሳባ ፡ እምየ ፡ ወእነግሥ ፡ በዝየ ፨
sentences.l: And-you-as-for, if he-made-you-great God-of your-fathers, you-will-go to throne-of your-father. And-said-to-her her-son: No! not he-leaves you, my-mother, and-Meksaba my-mother, and-I-will-reign here.
sentences.i: As for you, if the God of your fathers makes you great, you will go to your father's throne. But her son said to her: 'No! I will not leave you, my mother, or Meksaba, my mother, and I will reign here.'
sentences.n: ወአንተሰ 'and as for you' (the enclitic -ሰ again marks contrast). ለእመ 'if' (ለእመ + perfect, 'if he has made you great'). አልሀቀከ: ʾa-causative of ልህቀ 'grow', 'make great', 3ms perfect + -ከ 'you'. አምላከ አበዊከ 'God-of your-fathers' (construct; አበዊከ is the broken plural of አብ 'father' + -ከ). ተሐውር 2ms imperfect of ሖረ 'go'. ወይቤላ ወልዳ 'and her son said to her' (ወልዳ = ወልድ + -ሃ 'her'). አልቦ 'there is none', used here as an emphatic 'No'. Uncertain: ኢየኀድግ has the 3ms prefix ይ- ('he will not leave'); I take it as the boy speaking of himself and render 'I will not leave' (?); then ኪያኪ (2fs object pronoun 'you') and a second object 'Meksaba', each with እምየ 'my mother' (እም + -የ). The next verb ወእነግሥ is plainly 1cs 'and I will reign'. በዝየ 'here' (በ- + ዝየ). The unit ends at ፨, a stronger stop.

sentences.t: ወአሐተ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ ሰክሩ ፡ ክልኤሆሙ ፡ እምድኅረ ፡ ኀለፈ ፡ ምሳሕ ፡ ወተዐጽወ ፡ ኀዋኅው ።
sentences.l: And-one day they-got-drunk both-of-them (m.), after passed lunch, and-were-shut the-doors.
sentences.i: One day the two of them were drunk (?), after the midday meal had passed and the doors had been shut.
sentences.n: ወአሐተ ዕለተ 'and one day' (አሐተ 'one' f. accusative, ዕለተ the accusative of ዕለት 'day', used adverbially). ሰክሩ 3mp perfect of ሰክረ 'be drunk'. Uncertain: ክልኤሆሙ is the masculine 'both of them' while the next unit says the two women were seated with the boys serving, so the drunk pair are probably the two boys; I give 'the two of them' to keep the ambiguity (?). እምድኅረ 'after' + perfect ኀለፈ 'passed'. ምሳሕ 'midday meal, lunch'. ተዐጽወ 3ms passive-reflexive perfect of ዐጸወ 'shut'; ኀዋኅው is the plural of ኆኅት 'door, gate'. The shut doors matter for the secrecy of what follows.

sentences.t: ወሀለዋ ፡ ይነብራ ፡ ክልኤሆን ፡ ከመ ፡ ይብልዓ ፡ ሥጋ ፡ ወእሙንቱኒ ፡ ደቂቅ ፡ ይትዋነዩ ፡ ቅድሜሆን ፡ ወይበልዑ ፡ ምስሌሆን ፡ ወአሐቲ ፡ አመት ፡ ትእኅዝ ፡ መጽብኀ ፡ በማእከሌሆን ።
sentences.l: And-they-were (f.) sitting both-of-them (f.) to-eat meat, and-those-also boys they-served before-them and-ate with-them, and-one maidservant held a-dish between-them.
sentences.i: The two women were sitting to eat meat, while the boys waited on them and ate with them, and one maidservant held a dish between them.
sentences.n: ወሀለዋ 'and they (f.) were' (ሀለወ 'be, exist' in 3fp: -ዋ). ይነብራ and ይብልዓ are 3fp forms (the ending -ā marks feminine plural): 'they sit', 'that they may eat' (ከመ + subjunctive). ክልኤሆን is the feminine 'both of them', so here the two women, Meksaba and Delilah. ወእሙንቱኒ ደቂቅ 'and those (m.) too, the boys' (እሙንቱ 'those' + -ኒ 'also'; ደቂቅ plural of ወልድ in the sense 'children'). ይትዋነዩ is the tä-stem of ዋንየ 'serve, wait on', 3mp imperfect; the people eat 'with them'. ትእኅዝ 3fs imperfect of አኀዘ 'hold'. መጽብኅ 'dish, large platter' (spelled መጽብኀ in this unit, the object form, and መጽብኅ later). በማእከሌሆን 'between them' (በ- + ማእከል 'middle' + -ሆን f.).

sentences.t: ወነሥአ ፡ አኬሜሔል ፡ ወልደ ፡ ደሊላ ፡ ሥጋ ፡ ምልአ ፡ ክልኤሆን ፡ እደዊሁ ፡ እምነ ፡ መጽብኅ ፡ ወተፍእመ ፤
sentences.l: And-took Akemehel son-of Delilah meat, fill-of both his-hands, from the-dish, and-crammed-his-mouth(?).
sentences.i: Akemehel, the son of Delilah, took meat from the dish, as much as both his hands could hold, and crammed his mouth with it (?).
sentences.n: ወነሥአ 'and he took' (ነሥአ 3ms perfect). Akemehel is called ወልደ ደሊላ 'son-of Delilah' (construct), to tell him from Meksaba's son. ምልአ ክልኤሆን እደዊሁ: ምልአ is the construct of ምልእ 'fullness', 'the fill of both his hands'; ክልኤሆን is feminine because እደው 'hands' is treated as a feminine dual. እምነ መጽብኅ 'from the dish'. Uncertain: ተፍእመ is not a form I can place with certainty; from the next unit (what 'remained from his mouth' is seized), I take it as 'was stuffed / crammed his mouth' (?).

sentences.t: ወዘአትረፈ ፡ እምአፉሁ ፡ ጠለፎ ፡ ወልደ ፡ መክሳባ ፡ ጥብሬሌስ ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ኢሎፍሊ ።
sentences.l: And-that-which he-left-over from his-mouth, snatched-it son-of Meksaba, Tibreles, king-of Philistines.
sentences.i: And what was left over from his mouth, the son of Meksaba, Tibreles, the king of the Philistines, snatched.
sentences.n: ዘአትረፈ 'that which he left over' (ዘ- 'that which' + ʾa-causative አትረፈ of ተርፈ 'remain', 'let remain'). ጠለፎ 'he snatched it' (ጠለፈ 'snatch, seize' + -ሁ 'it'; I rely on Dillmann for the meaning, but a little doubt remains, ?). The king is named ወልደ መክሳባ ጥብሬሌስ 'son-of Meksaba, Tibreles'; I write his name as Tibreles from ጥብሬሌስ (Ṭəbrelēs), a name found nowhere else that I know of (?). ንጉሠ ኢሎፍሊ 'king-of Philistines' (construct): the boy is already king, as the end of ch. 80 told.

sentences.t: ወአውፅአ ፡ ሰይፎ ፡ አኬሜሔል ፡ ወአውቀዮ ፡ ርእሶ ፡ ወወድቀት ፡ ውስተ ፡ መጽብኅ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ የኀጥ ፡ እንተ ፡ ሄደ ፤
sentences.l: And-drew-out his-sword Akemehel and-cut-off(?) his-head, and-it-fell into the-dish, before he-swallows(?) that-which went(?).
sentences.i: Akemehel drew his sword and struck off his head, and it fell into the dish before he could swallow what he had taken (?).
sentences.n: አውፅአ is the ʾa-causative of ወፅአ 'go out', so 'bring out, draw' (a sword); ሰይፎ 'his sword' (ሰይፍ + -ሁ). አውቀዮ: Uncertain; I take it as a verb of cutting, 'cut off' (?), with ርእሶ 'his head' (ርእስ + -ሁ) as its object, since the head then 'falls' (ወድቀት, 3fs perfect of ወድቀ, feminine because ርእስ is feminine). ውስተ 'into'. The last clause is obscure (?): ዘእንበለ 'without, before' + የኀጥ (which I read as an imperfect 'he swallows', cf. ውኅጠ 'swallow' in the next unit) + እንተ ሄደ 'which went'; the sense seems to be that the king died with the morsel still unswallowed. The unit ends at ፤.

sentences.t: ወሥጋሁኒ ፡ ወድቀ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጸፍጸፈ ፡ ቤት ፡ ወአንቀጥቀጠ ፡ እዴሁ ፡ ወእገሪሁ ፡ ወተፈጸመ ፡ ሶቤሃ ።
sentences.l: And-his-body-too fell onto floor-of the-house, and-shook his-hands and-his-feet, and-was-finished at-once.
sentences.i: And his body fell too, onto the floor of the house, and his hands and feet jerked, and he was finished at once.
sentences.n: ሥጋሁኒ 'his body also' (ሥጋ + -ሁ + -ኒ 'also'). ጸፍጸፈ ቤት 'floor-of house' (construct). አንቀጥቀጠ is the ʾa-causative of ተቀጥቀጠ, 'cause to tremble': 'he made his hands and feet shake' (the 'he' is the dying king; I render it 'jerked'). እዴሁ ወእገሪሁ 'his hands and his feet' (the dual-type forms እድ 'hand', እግር 'foot' + -ሁ). ተፈጸመ 'was completed, was finished' is the plain verb of death. ሶቤሃ 'at once, then' (ሶበ + -ሃ).

sentences.t: ወእማንቱሰ ፡ እማቲሆሙ ፡ አኀዞን ፡ ፍርሀት ፡ ወድንጋፄ ፡ ወኢነገራ ፡ ወኢለመኑሂ ፡ እስመ ፡ ፈርሃ ፡ ወውኅጣ ፡ ዘውስተ ፡ አፉሆን ፡ ወተናጸራ ፡ እስመ ፡ ኢያእመራ ፡ ዘይገብራ ፤
sentences.l: And-those-as-for, their-mothers (of the boys), seized-them fear and-dismay, and-they-told-not and-to-no-one, for they-feared, and-swallowed that-which in their-mouths, and-looked-at-each-other, for they-knew-not what they-should-do;
sentences.i: As for the two women, the boys' mothers, fear and dismay seized them. They told no one, for they were afraid. They swallowed what was in their mouths and looked at each other, for they did not know what to do;
sentences.n: ወእማንቱሰ 'and as for those (f.)' (እማንቱ 'those women' + -ሰ). እማቲሆሙ 'their mothers' (እም, plural እማት, + -ሆሙ, the boys' mothers). አኀዞን 'seized them (f.)' (አኀዘ + -ዎን), with ፍርሀት ወድንጋፄ 'fear and dismay' as subjects. ኢነገራ 'they did not speak' (3fp perfect); ወኢለመኑሂ 'nor to anyone' (ኢ- + ለ- + መኑ 'who' + -ሂ). ፈርሃ is written as 3ms, though the subject is the two women: loose agreement. ውኅጣ 'they swallowed' (ውኅጠ). ዘውስተ አፉሆን 'that which was in their mouths'. ተናጸራ: tä- reciprocal stem of ነጸረ 'look', so 'they looked at one another'. ኢያእመራ 'they did not know' (ኢ- + አእመረ). ዘይገብራ 'what they should do' (ዘ- + 3fp imperfect of ገብረ 'do'). Unit ends at ፤.

sentences.t: ወይእቲሰ ፡ አመት ፡ ተንሥአት ፡ እምኔሆን ፡ ወነሥአት ፡ ርእሶ ፡ እምነ ፡ መጽብኅ ፡ ወአስተጣግዐት ፡ ዲበ ፡ ክሳዲ ፡ ወከደነቶ ፡ ልብሳ ።
sentences.l: And-she-as-for, the-maidservant, rose from-among-them and-took his-head from the-dish and-set-it(?) upon neck(?) and-covered-it her-garment.
sentences.i: But the maidservant got up from among them, took his head from the dish, and lifted it onto her shoulder (?) and covered it with her garment.
sentences.n: ወይእቲሰ 'and as for her' (ይእቲ 'she' + -ሰ), then አመት 'the maidservant' in apposition. ተንሥአት 'rose' (3fs). እምኔሆን 'from them (f.)' (እም + -ኔ- + -ሆን). ነሥአት 'she took', ርእሶ 'his head' (the dead king's), እምነ መጽብኅ 'from the dish'. Uncertain: አስተጣግዐት is a verb I cannot parse securely (?); with ዲበ ክሳዲ 'upon neck', I take it as 'she set it up, hoisted it' onto her neck or shoulder, and ክሳዲ is the neck as it appears (the suffix is missing, so 'her' is my inference, ?). ከደነቶ 'she covered it' (ከደነ 'cover' + -ሁ), with ልብሳ 'her garment' (ልብስ + -ሃ).

sentences.t: ወተንሥአት ፡ ደሊላ ፡ ወመልኀት ፡ ሰይፈ ፡ ምውት ፡ ወልደ ፡ እኅታ ፡ ወሖረት ፡ ከመ ፡ ትቅትሎ ፡ ለኣኬሜሔል ፤
sentences.l: And-rose Delilah and-drew sword-of the-dead, son-of her-sister, and-went to-kill-him, Akemehel;
sentences.i: Delilah got up, drew the sword of the dead man, her sister's son, and went to kill Akemehel;
sentences.n: ወተንሥአት ደሊላ 'and Delilah rose'. መልኀት 'she drew out' (መልኀ 'draw, pull out', as of a sword); ሰይፈ ምውት 'the sword-of the-dead (one)' (construct, ሰይፈ), with ምውት 'dead' used as a noun, then ወልደ እኅታ 'son-of her sister' in apposition: the dead king is Meksaba's son, Delilah's nephew. ሖረት 'she went'. ከመ ትቅትሎ 'that she might kill him' (ከመ + 3fs subjunctive + -ሎ), and the object is repeated as ለኣኬሜሔል 'namely Akemehel' (ለ- marks the object). The ኣ in this spelling is the Bezold form of the name, which also appears as አከምሔል.

sentences.t: ወውእቱሰ ፡ ተጸወነ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ምስዋረ ፡ ዐምድ ፡ ወተደለወ ፡ ለቀትለ ፡ እሙ ።
sentences.l: And-he-as-for hid at hiding-place-of a-pillar, and-made-himself-ready for-killing-of his-mother.
sentences.i: But he hid behind a pillar and made himself ready to kill his mother.
sentences.n: ተጸወነ is the tä-stem of ጸወነ ('take, protect'), so 'took cover, hid himself'. ምስዋረ ዐምድ: ምስዋር is the noun of place from ሰወረ 'hide', 'hiding place' (construct before ዐምድ 'pillar'), so ኀበ ምስዋረ ዐምድ 'at the hiding-place of a pillar', that is, behind a pillar. ተደለወ is the tä-stem of ደለወ 'prepare', here 'get ready'; ለቀትለ እሙ 'to kill (ቀትል, the verbal noun in construct) his mother', i.e. Delilah.

sentences.t: ወተንሥአት ፡ እኅታ ፡ ወአኀዘታ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ትብል ፡ ለምንት ፡ ተሀጐልነ ፡ እምካልኣኒሆሙ ፤
sentences.l: And-rose her-sister and-seized-her, saying: Why shall-we-be-lost from-their-others(?);
sentences.i: Her sister rose and seized her, saying: 'Why should we be lost, because of the others (?);
sentences.n: እኅታ 'her sister' is Meksaba; ወአኀዘታ 'and she seized her' (አኀዘ + -ታ). እንዘ ትብል 'saying' (እንዘ + 3fs imperfect of ይቤ: 'while she says'). ተሀጐልነ: tä-stem of ሀጐለ 'perish, be lost', here 'we are lost / shall be lost' in the first person plural (-ነ). Uncertain: እምካልኣኒሆሙ 'from their others' (እም- + ካልእ 'second, other' plural + -ሆሙ); I take Meksaba to mean 'why should we lose the rest as well' (?) and give a loose sense. The unit ends at ፤ and her speech continues in the next unit.

sentences.t: ወዝንቱሰ ፡ ዘጒንዲ ፡ እኩይ ፡ ኢይክል ፡ ፈሪየ ፡ ሠናየ ፡ ኒዒ ፡ እኅትየ ፡ ኪያኪኒ ፡ ኢያህጒልኪ ፡ ወነሥአት ፡ እምእዴሃ ፡ ሰይፈ ፡ ወአንሥአት ፡ እምትርኣሲሃ ፡ ልብሰ ፡ ሠናየ ፡ ዘሜላት ፡ ዘይለብሱ ፡ ነገሥት ፡ ወወሀበቶ ፡ ወየውሀቶ ፡ በጥዑም ፡ ቃል ፡ እንዘ ፡ ትብል ፡ ንሣእ ፡ ወልድየ ፡ ልብሰ ፡ ወትነብር ፡ አንተ ፡ ዲበ ፡ መንበረ ፡ መንግሥተ ፡ ኢሎፍሊ ፡ ወውእቱሰ ፡ ኮነ ፡ ፀዋገ ፡ ከመ ፡ ድብ ፡ እስመ ፡ ፈቀደ ፡ ይቅትሎን ፡ ለክል ፡ ኤሆን ፡ እስከ ፡ የኀድጋ ፡ ቤተ ፡ ወወፅኣ ፤
sentences.l: And-this-one-as-for, of-trunk evil, not he-can to-bear-fruit good. Come, my-sister, you-too not he-will-destroy-you. And-she-took from her-hand sword, and-lifted from her-store(?) garment good, of-purple(?) which wear kings, and-gave-it and-soothed-him(?) with-sweet word saying: Take, my-son, garment, and-you-will-sit, you, upon throne-of kingdom-of Philistines. And-he-as-for became lurking(?) like bear, for he-wanted he-kill-them both until they-left the-house, and-went-out;
sentences.i: 'As for this one, he is of an evil stock and cannot bear good fruit. Come, my sister. He will not destroy you either.' And she took the sword from her hand, and brought out of her store (?) a fine garment of purple (?), which kings wear, and gave it to him, and soothed him (?) with sweet words, saying: 'Take the garment, my son, and sit on the throne of the kingdom of the Philistines.' But he became watchful (?) like a bear, for he wanted to kill them both until they had left the house, and they went out;
sentences.n: This unit runs to about 49 words, a little over the usual limit, but has no ፤ inside it, so it is not cut. The speech of Meksaba continues: ዘጒንዲ እኩይ 'of evil trunk (stock)' (ጒንዲ 'stump, trunk'), the image of a bad tree that cannot ፈሪየ ሠናየ 'bear good fruit' (infinitive ፈሪ + accusative ሠናየ). ኒዒ is read as ንዒ, the feminine imperative 'come!' (?). ኢያህጒልኪ 'he will not destroy you' (ʾa-causative አህጐለ of ሀጐለ + -ኪ 2fs). Then ወነሥአት 'and she took' (Meksaba takes Delilah's sword) እምእዴሃ 'from her hand'. አንሥአት 'she lifted/brought out'. Uncertain: ትርኣስ 'store' (?), ሜላት (a costly cloth, 'purple' ?), ወየውሀቶ 'and soothed him' (?), ፀዋገ 'lurking / watchful' (?), the comparison ከመ ድብ 'like a bear' being sure. ዘይለብሱ 'which they wear' (ዘ- + 3mp of ለብሰ). ንሣእ is the imperative 'take!'; ወትነብር 'and you shall sit' (2ms). ይቅትሎን 'he kill them (f.)'; የኀድጋ 'they (f.) leave' (3fp, ending -ā). Source quirk: ለክል ፡ ኤሆን is a single word (ክልኤሆን 'both of them') split by a wordspace.

sentences.t: ወእምዝ ፡ ሶበ ፡ የኀድጋ ፡ ነሥአ ፡ ወለብሰ ፡ ሜላተ ፡ ወወፅአ ፡ አፍአ ፤
sentences.l: And-then when they-left (f.) he-took and-put-on the-garment and-went-out outside;
sentences.i: And then, when they had left, he took the garment, put it on, and went outside;
sentences.n: ወእምዝ 'and after this' (እም- + ዝ). ሶበ 'when'; የኀድጋ is 3fp, 'they (f.) leave'. ነሥአ and ለብሰ 'he took' and 'he put on' (ለብሰ 'wear, put on', with ሜላተ the accusative of ሜላት). ወፅአ 'went out'; አፍአ 'outside'.

sentences.t: ወእማንቱኒ ፡ ቦኣ ፡ ወገነዛ ፡ በድኖ ፡ ወቀበራሁ ፡ በጽምሚት ።
sentences.l: And-those-also entered and-wrapped his-corpse and-buried-him in-silence(?).
sentences.i: And the two women went in, wrapped his body, and buried him in secret (?).
sentences.n: ወእማንቱኒ 'and those (f.) also'. ቦኣ 'they (f.) entered' (ቦአ, 3fp). ገነዛ 'they wrapped' (ገነዘ 'wrap a corpse for burial'); በድኖ 'his corpse' (በድን + -ሁ). ቀበራሁ 'they buried him' (ቀበረ 'bury' + 3fp ending + -ሁ). በጽምሚት 'in silence' (በ- + ጽምሚት, from ጸመመ 'be silent'), here 'secretly' (?).

sentences.t: ወሶበ ፡ ኮነ ፡ ጊዜ ፡ ድራር ፡ ኀሠሥዎ ፡ ወኢረከብዎ ፡ ወተስእልዎ ፡ መሐዛት ፡ ወመገብት ፤
sentences.l: And-when it-was time-of supper they-sought-him and-did-not-find-him, and-asked-him(?) the-attendants(?) and-the-stewards(?);
sentences.i: And when it was time for supper they looked for him and did not find him, and the attendants (?) and stewards (?) asked about him;
sentences.n: ወሶበ ኮነ ጊዜ ድራር 'and when it was the time of supper' (ጊዜ construct before ድራር 'supper'). ኀሠሥዎ 'they sought him' (ኀሠሠ, 3mp + -ሁ); ወኢረከብዎ 'and did not find him' (ረከበ). ተስእልዎ is the tä-stem of ሰአለ 'ask', 'they inquired about him' (?). Uncertain: መሐዛት 'attendants' and መገብት 'stewards', which I connect with the roots አኀዘ 'hold' and ገብረ 'serve' (?); I take them as the subjects, the royal household officers.

sentences.t: ወትቤሎሙ ፡ እሙ ፡ እስመ ፡ ሐመ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ንጉሥክሙ ፡ ወዝንቱ ፡ ይነብር ፡ ህየንቴሁ ።
sentences.l: And-said-to-them his-mother: Because ill he, your-king, and-this-one will-sit in-his-place.
sentences.i: His mother said to them: 'Your king is ill, and this one will sit in his place.'
sentences.n: ወትቤሎሙ 'and she said to them' (ትቤ + -ሎሙ). Here እሙ 'his mother' is Meksaba, the king's mother. እስመ 'because, for' introduces the reported reason. ሐመ 'was ill' (3ms perfect). ንጉሥክሙ 'your king' (ንጉሥ + -ክሙ). ዝንቱ 'this (one)', i.e. Akemehel in the royal garment. ህየንቴሁ 'in his place, in his stead' (ህየንተ + -ሁ).

sentences.t: ወነሥእዎ ፡ ወአንበርዎ ፡ ወሠርዑ ፡ ማእደ ፡ ወተፈሥሑ ፤
sentences.l: And-they-took-him and-seated-him and-set a-table and-rejoiced;
sentences.i: They took him and seated him, and laid the table, and rejoiced;
sentences.n: Four plural perfects in a row: ነሥእዎ 'they took him', አንበርዎ 'they seated him' (ʾa-causative of ነብረ 'sit'; the object suffix -ዎ is 'him'), ሠርዑ 'they arranged' (ሠርዐ) ማእደ 'a table' (accusative of ማእድ), ተፈሥሑ 'they rejoiced' (ተፈሥሐ). The attendants are the subject.

sentences.t: ወእምአሜሃ ፡ ነግሠ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ሳምሶን ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘተዐደወ ፡ እምትእዛዙ ፤
sentences.l: And-from-then reigned the-son-of Samson over-them, and-there-was-none who-transgressed from-his-command;
sentences.i: From then on the son of Samson reigned over them, and no one transgressed his command;
sentences.n: ወእምአሜሃ 'and from then' (እም- + አሜሃ 'at that time'). ነግሠ 'he reigned' (ነግሠ 3ms perfect), ላዕሌሆሙ 'over them'. ወአልቦ ዘተዐደወ 'there was none who transgressed' (አልቦ 'there is not' + ዘ- + tä-stem perfect of ዐደወ 'cross, transgress'). ትእዛዙ 'his command' (ትእዛዝ + -ሁ).

sentences.t: እምዘ ፡ ፭ ፡ ክረምት ፡ ዘተወልደ ፡ ዘንተ ፡ ገብረ ፤
sentences.l: From-that five winters of-he-was-born, this he-did;
sentences.i: He did this when he was five years old;
sentences.n: A compressed time phrase: እምዘ ፭ ክረምት ዘተወልደ 'from [the] five winters of [his] being born', that is, five years after his birth. ክረምት 'rainy season, winter' counts as 'year'. ተወልደ 'was born' (tä-stem of ወለደ). The numeral ፭ is 5, spoken ኅምስቱ in the glossary. ዘንተ ገብረ 'he did this' (ዘንተ, the accusative of ዝንቱ; ገብረ 'did'). The source writes እምዘ and ፭ as separate words.

sentences.t: ወኮነት ፡ መንግሥተ ፡ ኢሎፍሊ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ወለዘርኡ ፡ እምድኅሬሁ ።
sentences.l: And-became kingdom-of Philistines to-him and-to-his-seed after-him.
sentences.i: And the kingdom of the Philistines became his, and his seed's after him.
sentences.n: ወኮነት 'and it became' (ኮነት 3fs, agreeing with መንግሥት 'kingdom', here in construct, መንግሥተ ኢሎፍሊ 'kingdom-of Philistines'). ሎቱ 'to him' (ለ- + -ቱ). ወለዘርኡ 'and to his seed' (ለ- + ዘርእ + -ሁ). እምድኅሬሁ 'after him' (እምድኅረ + -ሁ). The dynasty runs on from Akemehel, as in ch. 80.

sentences.t: ናሁኬ ፡ ተዐውቀ ፡ ከመ ፡ መንግሥተ ፡ ኢሎፍሊኒ ፡ ከመ ፡ ዘኮነ ፡ ለዘርአ ፡ ሴም ፡ ውእቱ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: Behold-then it-was-known that kingdom-of Philistines-too, as that-which was to-seed-of Shem, it.
sentences.i: So it is known that the kingdom of the Philistines too is, like the others, one that belonged to the seed of Shem.
sentences.n: ናሁኬ 'behold, then' (ናሁ 'behold' + enclitic -ኬ). ተዐውቀ 'it was known' (tä-stem of ዐወቀ). መንግሥተ ኢሎፍሊኒ 'the kingdom of the Philistines too' (-ኒ 'also'). ከመ ዘኮነ ለዘርአ ሴም ውእቱ: ከመ 'as', ዘኮነ 'that which was', ለዘርአ ሴም 'to the seed of Shem' (construct), ውእቱ 'it is'. The chronicle holds that all rightful kingdoms are Shem's (Genesis 10:21-31); Samson's tribe of Dan is a Semitic line, so the Philistine crown stays in his seed. The 'like the others' in my English is the sense of ከመ, taken loosely (?). The part ends with a double ፨ ፨.
